## Decision or hypothesis

What one decision or falsifiable hypothesis does this change test?

## Invariant

What must remain true?

## Evidence

List exact commands, suite/profile identity, and artifact links.

## Tradeoff

What does this optimize, and what does it give up?

## Result

- [ ] Correctness hard gates pass.
- [ ] Eval and implementation changes are separate.
- [ ] Proposed state is not described as current.
- [ ] Benchmark identity is complete, or this PR makes no benchmark claim.
- [ ] Rollback is clear.
